description: This file defines a React component 'QuizInstructionsModal' that displays a modal dialog with quiz instructions, rules, and an agreement checkbox. It manages user interactions such as closing the modal and starting the quiz upon agreement.

methods.name: QuizInstructionsModal
methods.description: React functional component that renders a modal with quiz instructions and agreement checkbox. Handles user confirmation to start the quiz.

methods.name: handleConfirm
methods.description: Handles the confirmation action when the user agrees and clicks the 'Start Quiz' button, calling 'onConfirm' and 'onClose' callbacks.
